points: For the first time, Hashem tells Yirmiyahu to write a message in a book, and surprisingly it's a message of hope.
Hashem will bring back those in exile, they will inherit the land, and the malchus will return.
The commentators explain: when you see the bad prophecies come true, know that the good ones will come true too.
For 2,000 years Jews saw the negative prophecies fulfilled and still believed in the positive ones.
We are living in the time of seeing the good ones come true, starting with the return to Eretz Yisrael.
